page.title: Pace converter
page.subtitle: Convert running speeds (mph, km/h, m/s), pace per mile or kilometer, and finish times for common race distances. Enter any field to update the rest.

speeds.title: Speeds
speeds.description: Treadmill-style speeds. Enter one value to derive pace and race times.
speeds.help: Digits only plus at most one decimal separator (. or ,). No letters or other symbols. Up to two decimal places when calculated (e.g. 6.5 mph). Leave blank to use pace or a finish time below.

paceMile.title: Pace per mile
paceMile.description: Minutes and seconds to cover one mile.
paceMile.help: Whole numbers only (no decimals). Seconds 0–59. Example: 9 minutes 30 seconds per mile.

paceKm.title: Pace per kilometer
paceKm.description: Minutes and seconds to cover one kilometer.
paceKm.help: Whole numbers only (no decimals). Seconds 0–59. Example: 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer.

races.title: Finish times
races.description: Total time for each distance at the current speed. Hours, minutes, and seconds are whole numbers only. If speeds and both paces are empty, a valid time in any row (5 km through marathon, in that order) sets the speed.

footer.note: Distances use 5 km, 10 km, 21.0975 km (half), and 42.195 km (marathon). Conversions follow standard mile and kilometer definitions (1 mi = 1609.344 m).
